sources.excerpt: Indian Constitution at Work Chapter Six JUDICIARY INTRODUCTION Many times, courts are seen only as arbitrators in disputes between individuals or private parties. But judiciary performs some political functions also. Judiciary is an important organ of the government. The Supreme Court of India is in fact, one of the very powerful courts in the world.
